Italian.reason: refers to the Italian language used in political commentaries cited as prior work; the paper only mentions it

Russian.reason: refers to Russian native speakers of annotators; the paper only mentions it

Turkish.reason: refers to Turkish native speakers of annotators; the paper only mentions it

German.reason: refers to German native speakers of annotators and as a language in cited prior work; the paper only mentions it

Spanish.reason: refers to Spanish native speakers of annotators and as a language in cited prior work; the paper only mentions it

English.reason: refers to the English language used in TED talk transcripts and corpora that the paper studies
